retrieval_corpus_real.json.note: ACCEPTED BY DESIGN. This corpus has no author: its records are real package.json files and its questions are derived from their descriptions by rule. Every defect below is the same one - the hard band thins a real sentence by removing words, which leaves a sentence a substring counter can still answer. A paraphrased band needs somebody to paraphrase, so this corpus cannot have one, and saying so is the finding rather than the excuse. A new defect here still fails the build; a pinned one that stops happening is reported as fixed.
